📊 What moved today, Tuesday 10 November

📉 Unemployment rose to 33.7% in July to September, even though 101,000 jobs were added.
📈 The JSE Top 40 closed 0.3% lower at 106,738.
💱 The rand weakened about 1% to around R16.54 to the dollar, and gold fell 2.7%.
⛽ Brent oil is still lower at about $91.82 a barrel, which helps December's petrol price, but a weaker rand pulls the other way.

Prices are 15-minute delayed. Education, not financial advice.
